subject: Barinade
text: In phase 1, move in, lock on to the tentacles on the ceiling, throw the boomerang, and move sideways.

evidence.quote: Phase 1. Move in on Barinade and Z-lock on his tentacles on the ceiling. Throw your boomerang and move sideways.

subject: Barinade phase 2
text: In phase 2, the rotating Bari cannot hit you if you stand against the wall, so lock on to Barinade and wait for an opening.

evidence.quote: Phase 2. The rotating Bari (jellyfish things) can't hit you if you are against the wall. Z-lock on Barinade and look for an opening while the Bari are rotating.

subject: Barinade phase 2
text: In phase 2, hit Barinade with a boomerang, then five sword hits, then dodge back immediately.

evidence.quote: Move in and hit him with a boomerang. Then hit him 5 times with your sword and immediately dodge back.

subject: Barinade phase 3
text: In phase 3, keep Z-locked on Barinade, move sideways and back, and keep throwing the boomerang.

evidence.quote: Try to get a Z-lock on as soon as possible and keep moving sideways and back while continuously throwing your boomerang.

subject: Barinade phase 3
object: Bari destroyed with boomerang after stun
text: After stunning Barinade in phase 3, lock on to one Bari and hit it with the boomerang; you may destroy 2 or 3 in one stun.

evidence.quote: Once he is stunned, try to get a Z-lock on on one of the Bari and hit it with a boomerang. If you are lucky with the Z-lock on, you may get 2 or 3 in a single stun.

subject: Barinade phase 3
text: In phase 3, deal with the Bari one at a time and watch for electricity beams rather than rushing.

evidence.quote: Don't rush it though and watch out for the electricity beams. It's better to stay safe and do 1 at a time.

subject: Barinade phase 4
text: In phase 4, stay at a distance, because Barinade zaps you with lightning when you are too close.

evidence.quote: If you are too close to Barinade, he will immediatly zap you with lighting, so get some distance and then try to get the Z-lock on on Barinade.

subject: Barinade phase 4
text: In phase 4, after a boomerang hit, close in and slash with the sword until Barinade burrows into the ground.

evidence.quote: Once hit, move in immediately and start slashing with your sword until he burries into the ground.

subject: Barinade phase 4
text: Once Barinade resurfaces in phase 4, repeat the cycle 2 more times to defeat him.

evidence.quote: Once he gets out of the ground and starts moving again, repeat this step 2 more times and the boss will be dead.

subject: Barinade phase 4
text: In phase 4, keep moving sideways to avoid the electricity.

evidence.quote: Keep moving sideways to avoid the electricity.

subject: Barinade jellyfish

evidence.quote: stun Barinade with boomerang and use Din's Fire if you have it.

subject: Barinade jellyfish

evidence.quote: deku nuts will take out the jellyfish instantly if they're not tethered to the main body.
